title: Windows Service Stop Via Net  and SC Application
author: Teoderick Contreras, Splunk
description: The following analytic has been deprecated. The following analytic identifies attempts to stop services on a system using `net.exe` or `sc.exe`. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names, GUIDs, and command-line executions. This activity is significant as adversaries often terminate security or critical services to evade detection and further their objectives. If confirmed malicious, this behavior could allow attackers to disable security defenses, facilitate ransomware encryption, or disrupt essential services, leading to potential data loss or system compromise.
